```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(e1071)

# Ajustar la ruta si el CSV está en otra carpeta
df <- read_delim("dataset.csv", delim = ";", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Se pasa el dataset a Observable JS (los filtros del sidebar trabajan sobre esto)
ojs_define(
  datos   = df,
  niveles = sort(unique(df$parent_education)),
  rango_a = range(df$attendance_rate)
)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
data = transpose(datos)

media = (arr, f) => arr.length ? arr.reduce((s, d) => s + f(d), 0) / arr.length : NaN
```

# {.sidebar}

**Filtros**

```{ojs}
viewof genero = Inputs.checkbox(["Female", "Male"],
  {label: "Género", value: ["Female", "Male"]})

viewof internet = Inputs.checkbox(["Yes", "No"],
  {label: "Acceso a internet", value: ["Yes", "No"]})

viewof extra = Inputs.checkbox(["Yes", "No"],
  {label: "Extraescolares", value: ["Yes", "No"]})

viewof educ = Inputs.checkbox(niveles,
  {label: "Educación de los padres", value: niveles})

viewof asist_min = Inputs.range(rango_a,
  {label: "Asistencia mínima (%)", step: 1, value: rango_a[0]})

filtrado = data.filter(d =>
  genero.includes(d.gender) &&
  internet.includes(d.internet_access) &&
  extra.includes(d.extracurricular) &&
  educ.includes(d.parent_education) &&
  d.attendance_rate >= asist_min
)
```

# Resumen

## Row {height=20%}

```{ojs}
//| content: valuebox
//| title: "Estudiantes"
({color: "#e8f0f8", value: filtrado.length})
```

```{ojs}
//| content: valuebox
//| title: "Nota final promedio"
({color: "#e8f0f8",
  value: media(filtrado, d => d.final_score).toFixed(1)})
```

```{ojs}
//| content: valuebox
//| title: "% de aprobados"
({color: "#e3f4ef",
  value: (100 * media(filtrado, d => d.passed === "Yes" ? 1 : 0)).toFixed(1) + "%"})
```

```{ojs}
//| content: valuebox
//| title: "Asistencia promedio"
({color: "#e8f0f8",
  value: media(filtrado, d => d.attendance_rate).toFixed(1) + "%"})
```

```{ojs}
//| content: valuebox
//| title: "Horas de estudio / semana"
({color: "#e8f0f8",
  value: media(filtrado, d => d.study_hours_per_week).toFixed(1)})
```

## Row {height=80%}

```{ojs}
//| title: ¿Dónde se concentran las notas finales?
Plot.plot({

  marks: [
    Plot.rectY(filtrado, Plot.binX({y: "count"},
      {x: "final_score", thresholds: 25, fill: "steelblue"})),
    Plot.ruleY([0])
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| title: ¿Influye el nivel educativo de los padres?
Plot.plot({
  marginLeft: 90,
  x: {label: "% de estudiantes", percent: true, grid: true},
  y: {label: null},
  color: {domain: ["Yes", "No"], range: ["#2a9d8f", "#e76f51"],
          legend: true, label: null},
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(filtrado, Plot.groupY({x: "count"},
      {y: "parent_education", fill: "passed", offset: "normalize", tip: true})),
    Plot.ruleX([0])
  ]
})
```

# Relaciones

## Column {width=60%}

```{ojs}
//| title: ¿Estudiar más sube la nota?
Plot.plot({
  x: {label: "Horas de estudio por semana"},
  y: {label: "Nota final", grid: true},
  color: {domain: ["No", "Yes"], range: ["#e76f51", "#2a9d8f"],
          legend: true, label: "Aprobó"},
  marks: [
    Plot.dot(filtrado, {x: "study_hours_per_week", y: "final_score",
      stroke: "passed", r: 3, fillOpacity: 0.4,
      title: d => `ID: ${d.student_id}`, tip: true})
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| title: ¿La nota anterior anticipa la final?
Plot.plot({
  x: {label: "Nota anterior"},
  y: {label: "Nota final", grid: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.dot(filtrado, {x: "previous_score", y: "final_score",
      fill: "steelblue", fillOpacity: 0.5, r: 3, tip: true}),
    Plot.linearRegressionY(filtrado, {x: "previous_score", y: "final_score",
      stroke: "#e76f51"})
  ]
})
```


# Horas de estudio

## Column {width=55%}

```{ojs}
//| title: Histograma con intervalos de clase (responde a los filtros)
Plot.plot({
  x: {label: "Horas de estudio por semana"},
  y: {label: "Frecuencia absoluta", grid: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.rectY(filtrado, Plot.binX({y: "count"},
      {x: "study_hours_per_week", thresholds: 8, fill: "steelblue"})),
    Plot.ruleY([0])
  ]
})
```

## Column {width=45%}

```{r}
#| title: Tabla de frecuencias (dataset completo, TP1)
breaks <- seq(min(df$study_hours_per_week), max(df$study_hours_per_week),
              length.out = 9)

df |>
  mutate(intervalo = cut(study_hours_per_week, breaks = breaks,
                         include.lowest = TRUE)) |>
  count(intervalo, name = "frec_abs") |>
  mutate(
    frec_rel  = frec_abs / sum(frec_abs),
    frec_porc = frec_rel * 100,
    frec_acum = cumsum(frec_abs)
  ) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(c(frec_rel, frec_porc), decimals = 2) |>
  cols_label(intervalo = "Intervalo", frec_abs = "Frec. abs.",
             frec_rel = "Frec. rel.", frec_porc = "%",
             frec_acum = "Frec. acum.")
```

```{r}
#| title: Interpretación
asim     <- round(skewness(df$study_hours_per_week), 2)
amplitud <- round(breaks[2] - breaks[1], 1)
```

Amplitud de clase: **`{r} amplitud` horas**. Asimetría: **`{r} asim`**.
Al ser un valor cercano a 0, la distribución es aproximadamente simétrica.

# Datos

```{ojs}
//| title: Dataset (responde a los filtros)
Inputs.table(filtrado, {
  columns: ["student_id", "gender", "age", "study_hours_per_week",
            "attendance_rate", "parent_education", "internet_access",
            "extracurricular", "previous_score", "final_score", "passed"],
  rows: 15
})
```
